prompt: Walk me through Dan Koe's 'formula' from The Art of Focus for reinventing myself.
assertions: Starts with an anti-vision: detailed writing of the life you don't want until uncomfortable
Then a vision derived from the anti-vision; big, emotionally compelling; 'dance between' them for daily decisions
Purpose turned into a big goal / path of mastery
Breaks into yearly, monthly, weekly and daily goals
Mentions self-discipline as desire for highest self outweighing cheap pleasures, or goals that repel distractions
